RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday,  July 26, 2010/Sravana 4, 1932 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Coal; Corporate Affairs; Development of North Eastern Region;
Environment and Forests; Food Processing Industries; Information and
Broadcasting; Law and Justice; Mines; Minority Affairs; New and
Renewable Energy; Power; S tatistics and Programme
Implementation; Tribal Affairs;Women
and Child Development)
Total number of questions — 20
Differential treatment in
environmental clearances
*1. SHRI MANI SHANKAR AIYAR:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether, on environmental grounds,
a slum was dismantled at Yamuna Pushta
on the right bank of the river whereas
environmental clearance was granted for
constructing a permanent Commonwealth
Games Village on the left bank of the river
almost opposite the site where the slum on
the right bank was dismantled; and
(b) if so, the reasons for the differential
treatment of the two cases?
Reservation for minorities
†*2. SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS: Will
the Minister of MINORITY AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the advice given by the Ministry on
efforts being made for unconstitutional
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
reservation in the name of minority
communities;
(b) whether the existing facilities being
given to the minority communities by
Government are not enough despite the fact
that there is no provision of reservation for
them; and
(c) the steps being taken by
Government in educating the minorities in
this regard?
Tapping of solar energy
*3. SHRIMATI T. RATNA BAI: Will
the Minister of NEW AND RENEWABLE
ENERGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the States are tapping the
solar energy potential;
(b) if so, the details thereof during the
last three years, State-wise;
(c) the amount spent in this regard;
(d) the present status thereof; and
1

2
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(e) how Government is using such solar
energy, State-wise?
Supply of sub-standard coal to
Satpura Thermal Power Plant
†*4. SHRI SATYA VRAT
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether an instance of supplying
stones/substandard coal to the Satpura
Thermal Power Plant by the Western Coal-
fields Ltd. in May, 2010 has come to the
light;
(b) if so, the persons responsible
therefor;
(c) whether it is a fact that power
generation has fallen due to the inadequate
supply of coal to the plant; and
(d) if so, Government's reaction thereto?
Anganwadi Karyakartri Bima Y ojana
*5. SHRIMATI VIPLOVE THAKUR:
Will the Minister of WOMEN AND
CHILD DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has launched
'Anganwadi Karyakartri Bima Yojana', a
scheme for the welfare of Anganwadi
Workers;
(b) if so, the salient features thereof;
and
(c) the details of the persons registered
under this scheme so far, State-wise?
Setting up of merchant plants by
NTPC
*6. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR: Will the
Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that NTPC
proposes to set up merchant plants, the
output from which will be sold in the open
market;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) Government's reaction in this
regard?
24 hour channel for Assam
*7. SHRI KUMAR DEEPAK DAS:
Will the Minister of INFORMATION
AND BROADCASTING be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has any
proposal for 24 hour channel exclusively
for regional programmes of Assam in
Guwahati Doordarshan under D.D.
Network;
(b) if not, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government is aware that
the programme producers, directors,
technicians and artists of Assam are not
getting good opportunity to use their talent,
as the slots in NE channels are not
sufficient; and
(d) if so, the details of the action taken
in this regard?
Adherence to mining laws
*8. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of MINES be pleased to state:
(a) the number of existing companies/
Central Public Sector Undertakings
(CPSUs) granted mining lease/engaged in
mining of iron-ore and other minerals in the
country, State-wise, Company/CPSU-wise
and mineral-wise;
(b) whether these companies are
following the mining laws;

3
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the corrective measures taken
by Government against the erring
companies?
Norms for auction of coal bearing
blocks
*9. SHRI PYARIMOHAN
MOHAPATRA: W ill the Minister of
COAL be pleased to state:
(a) the norms under which certain coal
bearing blocks have been proposed to be
reserved for auction;
(b) the number of such blocks, State-
wise, along with the estimated reserves of
coal therein;
(c) whether the proceeds of  such
auction would be made available fully to
the respective States; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Scholarship to minority girls
*10. PROF. ANIL KUMAR SAHANI:
Will the Minister of MINORITY AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of girls belonging to
minority communities awarded scholarship
under the Maulana Azad National
Schola
